Time PickerText inputs

The `m3e-timepicker` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3eelbuildHTML
[ M3e.formField [ M3e.FormField.variant M3e.Values.outlined ]
[ M3e.FormField.label (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "fld1" ] [ Kit.text "Time Field" ])
, TypedHtml.input
[ Native.attribute "autocomplete" "off"
, Native.attribute "id" "fld1"
]
[]
, M3e.FormField.suffix
(M3e.iconButton [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Open time picker" ]
[ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "schedule" ] []
, M3e.timepickerToggle [ M3e.TimepickerToggle.for "timepicker" ] []
]
)
, M3e.FormField.hint (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "HH:MM" ])
]
, M3e.timepicker
[ M3e.Attributes.id "timepicker"
, M3e.Timepicker.variant M3e.Values.auto
]
[]
]

el is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the el surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for el on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

[ M3e.FormField.build
|> M3e.FormField.withVariant M3e.Values.outlined
|> M3e.FormField.withLabel (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "fld1" ] [ Kit.text "Time Field" ])
|> M3e.FormField.withChild
(TypedHtml.input
[ Native.attribute "autocomplete" "off"
, Native.attribute "id" "fld1"
]
[]
)
|> M3e.FormField.withSuffix
(M3e.IconButton.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Open time picker" ]
[ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "schedule" ] []
, M3e.TimepickerToggle.view [ M3e.TimepickerToggle.for "timepicker" ] []
]
)
|> M3e.FormField.withHint (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "HH:MM" ])
|> M3e.FormField.toElement
, M3e.Timepicker.view
[ M3e.Attributes.id "timepicker"
, M3e.Timepicker.variant M3e.Values.auto
]
[]
]
<m3e-form-field variant="outlined">
<label slot="label" for="fld1">Time Field</label>
<input autocomplete="off" id="fld1">
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Open time picker" slot="suffix">
<m3e-icon name="schedule"></m3e-icon>
<m3e-timepicker-toggle for="timepicker"></m3e-timepicker-toggle>
</m3e-icon-button>
<span slot="hint">HH:MM</span>
</m3e-form-field>
<m3e-timepicker id="timepicker" variant="auto"></m3e-timepicker>

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.Timepicker.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.Timepicker.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.Timepicker.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children].

type Is

The kind row m3e-timepicker produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.
